Detailed implementation plan: https://chatgpt.com/space/page_fa28a6b2fe70819199a0a178f96c7fb6
Current scope supersedes prior extraction/model research: CATEGORY LABELING ONLY. Data Labels catalog with names/descriptions, document/chunk targets and per-target automation; existing configured Decision model evaluates each category independently. Multiple labels or none may apply. Boolean inclusion/exclusion assignments; category chips; shared add/remove/reset editor; inline chunk markers. No extraction, arbitrary text values, summarization, new text model or dedicated model selector.
Manual document inclusions and exclusions survive re-ingestion. Old chunks and all assignments are deleted; new chunks receive automatic labels when eligible. Missing model skips automation without failing ingestion. Separate FK-backed tables prevent resource-ID collisions. Provisional server-owned probability cutoff 0.80 requires fixture calibration/review; persist decision policy and guard stale results.
Eighteen children preserve serial dependencies and cover persistence, Decision runtime, validated classification/edit Actions, generation lifecycle, scheduling, authorized projections, locators, UI, approval/E2E and review/coverage/final validation. No production implementation yet. Gate .1 remains open; UX approval .15 precedes E2E .16. Historical comments retain superseded research; this description and linked Page define current scope.

comments.text: Additional verified model configuration entry points: Zaq.System.get_rag_model_config(:decision), lib/zaq/system/rag_model_config.ex supports?/2, and Engine API get/save model configuration dispatch. Reuse this configuration owner; inspect its complete contract before planning automatic classification.

Detailed plan saved to https://chatgpt.com/space/page_fa28a6b2fe70819199a0a178f96c7fb6 and read back successfully: 18 delivery steps, 10 illustrative code blocks, a dependency diagram, source findings, operation contracts and planned tests. The user approved an extraction-capable text model; plan uses dedicated Labeling configuration. Children .1 through .18 carry step specifications and a serial dependency chain. Human UX approval .15 blocks consolidated E2E .16. Application implementation has not started; architecture/defaults review .1 remains open. Page preview rendering was unavailable; saved headings and code fences were verified.

Research update 2026-11-02: checked live OpenRouter decisions catalog (33 entries including aliases/free variants) and official API/model documentation. No documented arbitrary text-span extraction found in Decisions contract; choice/noul/score, plus model-specific outputs, remain typed judgments. Found specialized scaledown/extract: description-driven NER, matching text spans/confidence/offsets; catalog text output and Responses/Chat API, not Decisions endpoint. Sources: https://openrouter.ai/scaledown/extract ; https://openrouter.ai/docs/cookbook/evaluate-and-optimize/extract-invoice-fields-with-scaledown ; https://docs.scaledown.ai/api-reference/extract-overview . Candidate for Labeling model instead of general-purpose generation; requires provider-specific entities options, multiple-match policy and output normalization. Documentation research only; no inference benchmark and no Page/implementation changes.
